To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we have shown that the accuracy of quantized models is highly correlated to the distribution of the quantization error, and (2) we have proposed an optimization framework to minimize the quantization error by optimizing the quantizer parameters and the network weights jointly.

(1) the accuracy of a quantized neural network is a function of the number of bits allocated to the weights and activations; and, (2) the number of bits to be allocated to weights and activations can be determined by minimizing the quantization error, and that this number of bits is a function of both the model architecture and the dataset.

(i) quantizing weights and activations with 8 bits is sufficient to obtain the same accuracy as 16 bit floating point numbers; (ii) the quantization error can be reduced to a negligible level using optimal quantization, i.e. by minimizing the quantization error with respect to a given quantizer; and (iii) the quantization errors can be further reduced by training the model to be quantized.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of optimal binary quantization of weights and activations for deep neural networks.
the problem of quantizing weights and activations in deep neural networks to improve inference efficiency.
the following two aspects of quantization: • How to quantize the weights and activations in order to minimize the quantization error?

the quantized models can be as accurate as the full precision models, and in some cases can even outperform the latter.

we have developed a novel method that optimizes the quantization parameters of a neural network to minimize the quantization error and hence improve accuracy.

the quantization error can be reduced significantly by using a more sophisticated quantization scheme than simple rounding.
the quantization error can be significantly reduced by optimizing the quantization bins.
, by carefully designing a quantization scheme, we can achieve significant improvements in accuracy.
